title: LTS Rutherford Cable Workflow: a multiscale simulation pipeline for Nb3Sn Rutherford cables
description: Companion code for the SuST paper 'A Multiscale Modeling Framework for Accelerator Magnets Accounting for Fabrication-Induced Deformation and Operational Strain in Nb3Sn Rutherford Cables'. End-to-end automated pipeline: cable-parameter calculation, FreeCAD STEP geometry, Ansys Mechanical solid meshing, LS-DYNA compaction, ParaView deformed-strand extraction, APDL conformal submodel, 4-stage 2D MAPDL cablestack solve, and optional 3D compression-box magnetic coupling with per-strand Ic degradation.
